definitions.explanation: A spoken account of events or a narrative.
An exchange of ideas through speech.

examples.japanese: {面白|おもしろ}い{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いた。
これは{本当|ほんとう}の{話|はなし}です。
{長|なが}い{話|はなし}になるけど、{聞|き}いてくれる？
examples.english: It's going to be a long story — will you hear me out?

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ、おばあちゃんに{昔話|むかしばなし}を{読|よ}んでもらうのが{好|す}きだった。
examples.english: When I was a child, I loved having my grandmother read me old tales.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}から{聞|き}いた{話|はなし}がとても{面白|おもしろ}かったので、{家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}ってから{家族|かぞく}にも{話|はな}した。
examples.english: The story I heard from a friend was so interesting that I told my family about it when I got home.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}を{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: Please listen to what I have to say.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{楽|たの}しく{話|はなし}をした。
examples.english: I had a fun conversation with my friend.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}、{大事|だいじ}な{話|はなし}をしているところです。
examples.english: We're in the middle of an important conversation right now.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}とは{話|はなし}が{合|あ}うので、{一緒|いっしょ}にいると{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: I get along well in conversation with him, so it's fun being together.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}で{話|はなし}をしていたら、あっという{間|ま}に1{時間|じかん}が{過|す}ぎていた。
examples.english: I was chatting on the phone and before I knew it, an hour had passed.
I have something to talk about.

examples.japanese: その{話|はなし}は{後|あと}にしましょう。
その{話|はなし}は{聞|き}いたことがある。
{話|はなし}が{変|か}わりますが、{来週|らいしゅう}の{予定|よてい}はどうですか。
examples.english: Changing the subject, but what are your plans for next week?

examples.japanese: あの{話|はなし}はもう{終|お}わったと{思|おも}っていたが、また{新|あたら}しい{問題|もんだい}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: I thought that matter was already settled, but a new problem came up again.

notes:
{話|はなし} is an extremely common noun with three main meanings: story/tale, conversation, and topic/matter.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {話|はなし}をする: to have a conversation
- {話|はなし}を{聞|き}く: to listen to a story/what someone says
- {話|はなし}がある: I have something to discuss
- {話|はなし}が{長|なが}い: long-winded

USEFUL EXPRESSIONS:
- {話|はなし}が{上手|じょうず}: good at talking
- {話|はなし}が{合|あ}う: to get along well in conversation
- {話|はなし}が{変|か}わる: to change the subject
- {話|はなし}にならない: out of the question, absurd

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {昔話|むかしばなし}: old tale, folklore
- {世間話|せけんばなし}: small talk, chitchat
- {身|み}の{上|うえ}{話|ばなし}: one's life story
